messages:
alex_partnerships: Quick sync — finalizing the joint announce for the marketplace listing with our HW partner and primary SI. Need to lock embargo window, PR owner, landing page copy owner, SI quickstart, and localization scope. Proposed embargo: 2026-05-12 09:00 PT. Can we lock dates and owners?

olivia_pr: I can own the PR draft and press outreach. Need approved partner quotes by 2026-05-04 so agency can draft. Is agency looped? @maria_pm? :speech_balloon: 

maria_pm: Yup — I'll loop the agency today. I'll own landing hero and CTA copy. Need product 1-liner + feature matrix from @kevin_engineering by 5/2. Also will coordinate localization asks (EU/JP first).

kevin_engineering: SI docs + integration guide are nearly done. We can turn around a partner quickstart (with infra snippet) by 2026-05-02. We'll also add an "on-prem HW notes" section for the hardware partner — need legal-approved branding guidance for the badge.

jamal_sales: Sales side: asking for a joint webinar week of 2026-05-17 to ride the announcement. Do partners commit to that week? We need an SI enablement checklist so AEs can demo partner flows.

sam_ops: I'll run rehearsals. Suggested rehearsal timeline: internal dry-run 2026-05-08, partner rehearsal 2026-05-10. Recommend final content freeze + signoffs by 2026-05-11 EOD PT.

announce-bot: Reminder: press embargo metadata (headline, embargo ts, embargo contacts) must be entered into the announce tool by 2026-05-06 to hit agency timelines.

alex_partnerships: OK — putting owners into a short checklist so we can track. Please reply inline with any ETA changes.

alex_partnerships: ```
Launch checklist (high level)
- Embargo window: 2026-05-12 09:00 PT (owner: alex_partnerships)
- PR draft + agency loop: owner: olivia_pr (quotes due 2026-05-04)
- Landing hero + CTA + localization plan: owner: maria_pm (feature matrix from eng due 2026-05-02)
- SI quickstart + infra snippet + on-prem notes: owner: kevin_engineering (ETA 2026-05-02)
- HW badge assets + logo sign-off: owner: partner-legal + maria_pm (deadline 2026-05-06)
- Partner rehearsal + webinar logistics: owner: jamal_sales + sam_ops (target week 2026-05-17)
- Final signoff cutoff: 2026-05-11 EOD PT (owner: sam_ops)
```

olivia_pr: I'll add PR milestones to that checklist. Partner quote template below — please paste final quote in this thread: "Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference latency by X% while cutting costs Y%" (we'll swap numbers for each partner). Need legal for any quote approval.

maria_pm: Localization plan (short): EU: EN/DE/FR/ES; APAC pilot: JP/KR. Owners: EN (maria_pm), DE/FR (agency localization lead), JP (partner-localization contact). Deadline for translated hero copy: 2026-05-06.

kevin_engineering: Quickstart snippet (draft) — please review, copy-paste into partner docs: ```bash
# Quickstart: deploy Redwood inference via marketplace
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deploy -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"sku":"hw-accelerated-1","region":"us-west-2"}'
# then follow SI guide for network and key provisioning
```
Ping @maria_pm for landing code examples.

jamal_sales: Go/no-go asks from GTM: 1) partner legal logo ok, 2) SI quickstart verified by a partner SI, 3) PR quote approved, 4) landing page live in staging with localized copy. If any of these fail by cutoff, we move to fallback announce window.

sam_ops: Proposing final cutoff for all dependencies: 2026-05-11 23:59 PT. After that we lock and run rehearsals. If anyone cannot meet their owner date, call it out now.

kevin_engineering: No major blockers from eng. One ask: marketing needs to confirm data-retention blurb for on-prem note (legal asked). ETA for that blurb?

olivia_pr: I'll get legal to draft the blurb by 2026-05-05. Also partner logo approvals — partners need a signoff form, I'll send it today.

alex_partnerships: Sounds good. Action summary: each owner update this thread w/ final asset link or "on track" by their deadlines. I'll maintain a one-pager in the partner drive and post link here once created. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: On track — will post staging link for hero by 2026-05-03.

jamal_sales: I'll confirm webinar commitments with partner PMs by 2026-05-04.

announce-bot: Note: added reminder for embargo metadata on 2026-05-06.

sam_ops: Rehearsal calendar invites incoming later today. :calendar:

alex_partnerships: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. Ping me if anything slips.
